note.content: WAL removes reader/writer blocking but writers still take the single write lock, so two processes inserting at once queue behind each other.

note.content: Postgres gives each transaction a snapshot of row versions so readers never block writers; old versions are vacuumed later.

note.content: The enrich worker retries a failed item after 0.5 s, then 1 s plus a random 0-250 ms, then gives up after three attempts.

note.content: When many clients fail at once, retrying on the same schedule makes them collide again; adding random jitter to the backoff spreads the retries out.
